verdict.rationale: Runloop's Devboxes are explicitly documented as isolated sandboxed execution environments provisioned via SDK/API or CLI, with quickstart docs claiming a first devbox in under a minute and site marketing claiming <2s startup for 10GB images and 10k+ parallel sandboxes. SDKs, CLI, blueprints/prebuilt images, and a free trial all support quick one-call provisioning; missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmark confirming actual startup latency claims beyond vendor docs.
